memories.title: Commit message: Conventional Commits
memories.text: Pakai Conventional Commits untuk semua pesan commit, ditulis dalam bahasa Inggris.

memories.title: Never skip pre-commit hooks
memories.text: Never skip pre-commit hooks; fix the lint error instead of using --no-verify.

memories.title: Zona waktu WIB, timestamp UTC
memories.text: Zona waktu kerja saya WIB (UTC+7), tapi semua timestamp di database dan log disimpan dalam UTC.

memories.title: Short answers, code first
memories.text: Keep explanations short and give code first; I read Indonesian and English equally well.

memories.title: Jangan commit .env atau API key
memories.text: Jangan pernah commit file .env atau kunci API ke repo; gunakan secret manager atau file .env.local yang di-gitignore.

memories.title: Neovim, tab width per bahasa
memories.text: Editor utama saya Neovim dengan tab width 4 untuk Python dan tab asli untuk Go.

memories.title: Laptop ThinkPad Ubuntu 16 GB
memories.text: My laptop is a ThinkPad running Ubuntu 24.04 with 16 GB RAM, so heavy emulators are slow.

memories.title: Pak Hendra, mentor arsitektur
memories.text: Pak Hendra adalah mentor saya yang sering memberi saran arsitektur; kami ngobrol tiap Jumat sore.

memories.title: Atlas: Go 1.22 with chi
memories.text: Atlas is a payments API written in Go 1.22 using the chi router.

memories.title: Atlas pakai PostgreSQL 12 di VPS
memories.text: Atlas menyimpan data transaksi di PostgreSQL 12 yang di-host di satu VPS.

memories.title: Atlas pindah ke PostgreSQL 15
memories.text: Atlas sekarang memakai PostgreSQL 15 di Cloud SQL setelah migrasi bulan Agustus.

memories.title: Money as integer minor units
memories.text: All money amounts in atlas are stored as integer minor units (cents/sen); never use float64 for currency.

memories.title: sqlc dipilih daripada GORM
memories.text: Kami memilih sqlc daripada GORM untuk akses database di atlas karena query-nya perlu dikontrol manual.

memories.title: Idempotency-Key required on payments
memories.text: Every payment endpoint must require an Idempotency-Key header to prevent double charges.

memories.title: Deploy atlas via docker-compose VPS
memories.text: Deploy atlas dilakukan lewat docker-compose di VPS dengan perintah ssh lalu docker compose up -d.

memories.title: Deploy atlas via GitHub Actions GKE
memories.text: Deploy atlas sekarang lewat GitHub Actions yang membangun image dan menerapkan manifest ke cluster GKE; tidak ada lagi ssh manual.

memories.title: Atlas rate limit 100/min
memories.text: Atlas API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per merchant.

memories.title: Atlas rate limit raised to 300/min
memories.text: Atlas API rate limit was raised to 300 requests per minute per merchant.

memories.title: Verifikasi HMAC pada webhook
memories.text: Webhook dari payment gateway harus diverifikasi dengan signature HMAC-SHA256 sebelum diproses.

memories.title: Table-driven Go tests with -race
memories.text: Write table-driven tests in Go and run them with go test -race ./... before opening a PR.

memories.title: Rina, tech lead atlas
memories.text: Rina adalah tech lead atlas yang me-review semua PR; dia wajib approve perubahan di modul ledger.

memories.title: Ledger uses double-entry bookkeeping
memories.text: The ledger module uses double-entry bookkeeping: every transfer creates a debit row and a credit row that must sum to zero.

memories.title: Midtrans utama, Xendit cadangan
memories.text: Atlas terintegrasi dengan Midtrans sebagai payment gateway utama dan Xendit sebagai cadangan.

memories.title: zerolog JSON, never log PAN
memories.text: Logging in atlas uses zerolog with JSON output; never log card numbers or full PANs.

memories.title: Migrasi harus bisa di-rollback
memories.text: Migrasi database atlas memakai golang-migrate dan harus bisa di-rollback; jangan ubah file migrasi yang sudah di-merge.

memories.title: Atlas staging resets Sunday night
memories.text: Staging environment for atlas lives at staging.atlas.example.dev and is reset every Sunday night.

memories.title: Circuit breaker klien Midtrans
memories.text: Circuit breaker di klien Midtrans terbuka setelah 5 kegagalan berturut-turut dan dicoba lagi setelah 30 detik.

memories.title: Bungkus error dengan %w
memories.text: Error di atlas dibungkus dengan fmt.Errorf dan %w supaya bisa dicek dengan errors.Is.

memories.title: Atlas CI ~6 minutes
memories.text: Atlas CI runs on GitHub Actions and takes about 6 minutes, including integration tests with testcontainers.

memories.title: Atlas stays PCI-DSS friendly
memories.text: Atlas must stay PCI-DSS friendly: no cardholder data may touch our servers, only gateway tokens.

memories.title: Kebun: Flutter plant watering app
memories.text: Kebun is a Flutter app that helps home gardeners track plant watering schedules.

memories.title: Kebun pakai Provider
memories.text: State management di kebun memakai Provider.

memories.title: Kebun pindah ke Riverpod
memories.text: Kebun pindah ke Riverpod untuk state management karena Provider sulit dites.

memories.title: Drift local DB, Firestore sync
memories.text: Kebun stores data locally with Drift (SQLite) and syncs to Firebase Firestore when online.

memories.title: Deploy kebun lewat Fastlane
memories.text: Deploy kebun ke Play Store lewat Fastlane: jalankan fastlane android beta lalu promosikan ke production secara manual di console.

memories.title: Kebun minSdkVersion 21
memories.text: Kebun supports Android minSdkVersion 21.

memories.title: Kebun minSdkVersion raised to 23
memories.text: Kebun minSdkVersion was raised to 23 because of the notification plugin.

memories.title: Check mounted after await
memories.text: Never call setState after await without checking mounted; it crashed the plant detail screen before.

memories.title: Widget kecil, file maks 200 baris
memories.text: Widget di kebun dipecah kecil-kecil; satu file maksimal sekitar 200 baris.

memories.title: Notifikasi siram pakai local_notifications
memories.text: Notifikasi pengingat siram tanaman memakai flutter_local_notifications dan dijadwalkan sesuai zona waktu perangkat.

memories.title: Dewi, UI designer kebun
memories.text: Dewi is the UI designer for kebun; her Figma file is the source of truth for colors and spacing.

memories.title: Warna tema kebun
memories.text: Warna utama kebun adalah hijau daun #2E7D32 dengan aksen kuning; tema gelap memakai latar #121212.

memories.title: Test on physical low-end device
memories.text: Test on a physical low-end Android device before every release; emulators hide jank on image-heavy lists.

memories.title: Foto dikompres maks 800 KB
memories.text: Foto tanaman di-upload ke Firebase Storage setelah dikompres hingga maksimal 800 KB.

memories.title: go_router with named routes
memories.text: Kebun uses go_router for navigation with named routes only.

memories.title: flutter analyze dan dart format
memories.text: Gunakan flutter analyze dan dart format sebelum push; CI kebun gagal kalau ada warning.

memories.title: Kebun CI on Codemagic ~12 min
memories.text: Kebun's CI runs on Codemagic and takes roughly 12 minutes per build.

memories.title: UI strings via l10n only
memories.text: String UI kebun harus lewat file l10n (intl) dalam bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris; jangan hardcode teks.

memories.title: Plant care recurrence model
memories.text: Plant care schedules are stored as a recurrence rule (interval in days) plus a last-watered timestamp.

memories.title: iOS ditunda
memories.text: Kebun belum memakai iOS; rilis iOS ditunda sampai akun Apple Developer dibeli.

memories.title: Notes: markdown CLI in ~/notes
memories.text: Notes is a personal Python CLI for quick markdown notes stored in ~/notes as plain files.

memories.title: Notes pakai argparse
memories.text: CLI notes memakai argparse untuk parsing argumen.

memories.title: Notes pindah ke Typer
memories.text: CLI notes sekarang memakai Typer supaya subcommand dan help otomatis lebih rapi.

memories.title: Notes must work offline
memories.text: Notes must have zero network dependencies at runtime; it has to work offline.

memories.title: Front matter YAML catatan
memories.text: Format catatan: front matter YAML dengan field title, tags, dan created.

memories.title: Search uses ripgrep with fallback
memories.text: Notes search uses ripgrep under the hood, falling back to pure Python if rg is not installed.

memories.title: Sinkronisasi via git pribadi
memories.text: Sinkronisasi catatan dilakukan lewat git repo pribadi, bukan layanan cloud, supaya sederhana dan privat.

memories.title: Python 3.11, pytest, mypy strict
memories.text: Notes targets Python 3.11 and uses pytest with type hints checked by mypy --strict.

memories.title: notes new: nama file berawalan tanggal
memories.text: Perintah `notes new` membuat file berawalan tanggal ISO, misalnya 2026-10-11-judul.md.

memories.title: Tag format and index rebuild
memories.text: Tags in notes are lowercase, hyphenated words; the tag index is rebuilt on each search rather than cached.

memories.title: Install pakai pipx, dependency ringan
memories.text: Notes memakai pipx untuk instalasi; jangan tambah dependency berat seperti pandas.

memories.title: Notes deploy is pipx install
memories.text: Deploy of notes is just `pipx install --force .` from the repo; no server involved.

memories.title: Config di ~/.config/notes
memories.text: Konfigurasi notes disimpan di ~/.config/notes/config.toml, bukan variabel lingkungan.

memories.title: rich output, plain when not TTY
memories.text: Notes output uses rich for tables but must degrade to plain text when stdout is not a TTY.

memories.title: Firebase config is gitignored
memories.text: Kebun Firebase config comes from google-services.json which is gitignored; each dev downloads their own copy.

memories.title: Nightly backup to private Gitea
memories.text: Backup of the notes repo runs nightly via a cron job that pushes to a private Gitea instance.

memories.title: Pesan error singkat, exit non-zero
memories.text: Pesan error CLI notes ditulis dalam bahasa Inggris singkat dan exit code non-zero.

memories.title: Tests use tmp_path fixtures
memories.text: Tests for notes use tmp_path fixtures so the real ~/notes directory is never touched.

memories.title: Atlas secrets from Secret Manager
memories.text: Atlas secrets come from Google Secret Manager at startup; local dev uses .env.local.

memories.title: Jam ngoding pribadi malam hari
memories.text: Waktu pemrograman pribadi saya malam hari, pukul 20.00–23.00 WIB, sesudah pulang kantor.
